flag_declaration.description: Selects the firmware/recovery prebuilt signed with the specified keyset. Possible values: dev, premp, mp. It is used to construct the path to the shellball/recovery kernel image. e.g., device/google/desktop/redrix-prebuilts/firmware/${RELEASE_REDRIX_KEYSET}-signed. This flag will only be used by release builders since those are the only builders that sign the OS w/ MP or PreMP keys. Non-release builds are hard coded to use to use a dev signed shellball/recovery kernel image.

flag_declaration.name: RELEASE_REDRIX_PROVISION_IMAGE_VERSION
flag_declaration.description: The version of the provision image. For example: <version>. e.g., redrix-prebuilts/provision/redrix-${RELEASE_REDRIX_PROVISION_IMAGE_VERSION}.bin

flag_declaration.name: RELEASE_REDRIX_RECOVERY_KERNEL_BUILD_VERSION
flag_declaration.description: The build version of the recovery kernel. For example: 1.0. This is used to construct the path to the recovery kernel. e.g., redrix-kernels/[...]/recovery/[...]/vmlinuz_${RELEASE_REDRIX_RECOVERY_KERNEL_BUILD_VERSION}.image
